races.paceDynamic: Jet Noir is the only confirmed front runner in this ten-horse field and should be allowed an uncontested lead from the off. With Tap Tap Shamie and Maccarellu likely to track in behind as prominent racers, the pace will be steady rather than fierce, allowing the leader to dictate terms. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Aristelle, McElhattan, The Grey Venture and Last Man Standing will need the pace to be strong enough to set up their finishing kicks. This setup moderately favours prominent racers who can position close to the pace without having to make up significant ground, as the sustainable tempo may not provide enough collapse for the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Jet Noir Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Jet Noir gets an easy lead and maintains rhythm
scenarios.body: The front runner faces no early pressure and can kick clear approaching the last, with the hold-up horses left with too much to do. Prominent trackers like Tap Tap Shamie and Maccarellu are best placed to respond if the leader weakens.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Tap Tap Shamie or Maccarellu press Jet Noir early
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and sets up a tactical battle between the prominent racers, with Sean Bowen's experience on Tap Tap Shamie proving decisive. The hold-up horses get the stronger gallop they need but may still find the leaders too far clear.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong enough to set up closers
scenarios.body: The front group goes too fast and tie up in the closing stages, allowing the patient hold-up horses to mount their challenge. Aristelle and McElhattan have the strongest recent form to capitalize on this collapse scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Jet Noir stops quickly and no pace materializes
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no clear pace scenario, suiting the lightly raced horses who may have hidden improvement. Dream On Mick's recent win and long absence could be significant factors in this type of tactical scramble.

watchPoints.text: Jet Noir's jumping under pressure - faded badly last time when asked to quicken and may not handle sustained battle
Dream On Mick's fitness after 84-day break - lightly raced horses can improve but Philip Kirby's recent form is patchy
Aristelle wearing tongue tie for first time with inexperienced Leah Noreci - headgear changes can be significant but 10lb claimer is inexperienced
Tap Tap Shamie's position tracking the leader - Sean Bowen will want to avoid getting too far back given the likely steady pace
The pace development in first half-mile - if Jet Noir gets too easy a time the hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground

races.paceDynamic: Benmore emerges as the sole confirmed front runner with Big Zouk and Loulou Madrik capable of racing prominently early. With most of the field holding up (I Wish You, You Some Girl, Orkney Blue, Eaton Anne), Benmore should get an uncontested lead and dictate fractions over this extended trip. The lack of pace pressure means he can measure out his effort, while the hold-up horses face the challenge of making up significant ground on Good going. This setup moderately favours the front runner and prominent racers — sustainable pace with limited early speed gives the leaders a tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Benmore gets an easy lead and dictates modest fractions without pressure.
scenarios.body: Danny McMenamin can nurse him along before kicking clear, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up the leeway on this sounder surface. His recent Carlisle win on Good going confirms he handles these conditions perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is slower than anticipated and the field bunches approaching the home turn.
scenarios.body: The class horses I Wish You or You Some Girl can unleash their finishing kicks, with Patrick Wadge's booking of the former suggesting stable confidence after a short break. Quality tells in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Big Zouk or Loulou Madrik can track Benmore without over-racing early.
scenarios.body: They get first run on the leader while avoiding the traffic issues that could hinder the hold-up brigade. Sean Quinlan returns to Big Zouk after his recent Hexham win, suggesting connections are confident.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly searching and this turns into a test of staying power over the extended trip.
scenarios.body: The older horses You Some Girl and Eaton Anne can grind out the finish, with their experience over this type of distance proving crucial. Sean Bowen's presence on Eaton Anne for in-form Olly Murphy adds appeal.

watchPoints.text: Benmore must be watched closely if he gets an uncontested lead - his jumping and pace judgment will be crucial
Monitor the start for how aggressively Big Zouk and Loulou Madrik take up their prominent positions behind Benmore

races.paceDynamic: Kyntara, Rocheval, and Ballin Bay will ensure a relentless gallop from the outset over this stamina-sapping 3m1f trip. With three confirmed front-runners unwilling to give way, the early pace will be fierce and unsustainable. The field will string out dramatically as the race develops, with the pace-setters likely to pay for their exertions in the closing stages. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the genuine gallop will set up perfectly for patient tactics and strong finishers.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.body: The relentless early gallop will take its toll on Kyntara, Rocheval and Ballin Bay, allowing the patient hold-up brigade to sweep past. Jupiter Des Mottes and Dr Seb have the class and tactical speed to capitalise when the pace inevitably falls apart.

scenarios.body: Ballin Bay's recent hat-trick suggests peak form and if he can dictate terms without fierce early pressure, his stamina could see him home. The Rebecca Menzies runner has won his last three and Nathan Moscrop knows him well.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but not suicidal
scenarios.body: Ramo and Guernesey can track the leaders without getting embroiled in the early battle, positioning perfectly to strike. Venetia Williams' Ramo showed improved form last time and can exploit a strong but manageable gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders tie up badly leaving a sprint
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with the hold-up horses having too much to do in a slowly-run contest. This unlikely scenario would favour horses with tactical pace who can respond to pressure.

runners_data.comment: Useful on the Flat in France; won on second hurdle start; has potential off opening mark
runners_data.spotlight: Useful on the Flat in France, where he stayed well; returned from long absence with encouraging third on hurdle/stable debut at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) in February before 6l win at Carlisle (2m1f, soft) last month; could have potential off his opening mark, especially now up in trip.

runners_data.name: Disco Annie
runners_data.note: Confirmed hold-up type for Rebecca Menzies who has 2/20 strike rate in past fortnight and wears first-time tongue tie

runners_data.name: Kado Sacree
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 59-day break for Olly Murphy but poor recent form with six consecutive defeats

runners_data.name: Half Track
runners_data.note: Ten-year-old hold-up horse returning after 67-day absence with first-time visor and tongue tie for struggling N W Alexander yard

runners_data.name: Red Cadillac
runners_data.note: Hold-up type in excellent form with two wins from last four starts for Nicky Richards, only 29 days since last run

runners_data.name: Devon Skies
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong recent record including two wins from last five for Philip Kirby, just 37 days since last outing

runners_data.name: Rauzan
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner wearing first-time prickers for Lizzie Quinlan team, fresh from 14-day break but patchy recent form

runners_data.name: Yapper Hill
runners_data.note: Prominent runner for George Bewley with first-time tongue tie, only horse likely to pressure Tarbuck early

runners_data.name: Tarbuck
runners_data.note: Natural front runner returning after 70-day break for Claire Dyson, will likely get uncontested lead in this field composition

races.paceDynamic: Tarbuck is the sole confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead, with Yapper Hill the only other prominent runner likely to track him. The remaining seven runners all prefer to be held up, creating a classic scenario where the pace-setters face minimal early pressure over this stamina-testing trip. With soft going underfoot and a field predominantly composed of hold-up horses, the early gallop will be sedate, allowing Tarbuck to dictate terms without being harassed. This setup strongly favours the front runners and prominent racers — the lack of pace pressure means they can conserve energy and prove hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Tarbuck gets an easy lead and Yapper Hill tracks him without pressure...
scenarios.body: The pace becomes pedestrian with seven hold-up horses reluctant to commit early, leaving the front pair with too much in reserve. Tarbuck and Yapper Hill can kick clear before the hold-up brigade can mount their challenge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Finisher Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the higher-rated hold-up horses times their run perfectly despite the lack of pace...
scenarios.body: The soft ground aids stamina and a horse like Red Cadillac or Devon Skies could still overcome the tactical disadvantage with superior class. Their finishing kick just gets them up in the final strides.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is so slow that it becomes a sprint finish with all runners still in contention...
scenarios.body: The race turns into a bunched cavalry charge where any horse can win, favouring those with the best recent form regardless of running style. Raw ability trumps tactics in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unfancied hold-up horses benefits from a perfect passage through the field...
scenarios.body: A horse like Half Track or Disco Annie gets the ideal trip behind the slow pace and emerges late with Rebecca Menzies or N W Alexander providing a surprise winner. The race sets up perfectly for an outsider.

watchPoints.text: Tarbuck getting too easy a lead - if he's allowed to bowl along uncontested he could prove impossible to catch
Devon Skies and Red Cadillac getting decent positions early - both have winning form and could overcome tactical disadvantage
First-time headgear on Half Track (visor/tongue tie) and Yapper Hill (tongue tie) suggesting connections expect improvement
The early pace setting - if it's as slow as expected the hold-up horses face an almost impossible task
Sean Bowen's booking for Kado Sacree suggests Olly Murphy expects better after the long break despite poor recent form
